# Introduction

This part explains what dynamic instrumentation is, why rz-frida exists, how
to install it, and what happens under the hood when we open a session.

If you already know Frida and have the plugin installed, continue
with [First Steps](../first_steps/intro.qmd) to set up the lab.

| [How it works](how_it_works.qmd) | the architecture: rizin, frida-core, the injected agent, JSON envelopes |
